notes.title: Patch (2018.07.19)
notes.notes:
Huge Patch.

-Retro styled save/load system implemented to the game.
(You can save your game with a red keycard at the save machine.)
-New areas are reachable.

Small Patch.

-New runner zomie added to the game.
-New red hazard zomie added to the game.(save keycard)
-New yellow hazard zomie added to the game.(gate keycard)
-More turret added.
-Spider queen health decreased.
-Canned food added.(100% food level)
-Radio added with 10 8bit musics.
-Texture and visual bugs fixed at kitchen.
-The player is now ignore the Order balls colliders.
-The player is now ignore the dirt bags colliders.
-Performance optimisation.
-Carried objects speed increased.

Thanks for your cooperation! You can make the game better.

notes.title: Patch (2018.06.16)
notes.notes:
-No one can go throuth the walls.(AI updated)
-You can't add a new dirt bag to the search bench,while Emily is not finished.(Wasting fix)
-Now there are 4 different sized spider ,with different health level.
-Now you cant pick up the meltform while it's hot.
-Destroyed hazard barrels,fill deadly gas to the air,for a few sec.
-You can dig up the spider nest with you shovel.Hammer is useful for that.
-Generator has collider at the top.
-There's no more filled bottle in the dirt. sorry :(

notes.title: Patch (2018.06.10)
notes.notes:
-Normal map Textures added for all models.
-Better Zombie AI.
-Turret upgrade part fixed.
-Meat flash dropped fom the enemy when its damaged.
-More upgrade part added to Lobby level.
-Enemies now can do lower damage.
-Radioactive Barrels now destroyable.

notes.title: Patch (2018.05.24)
notes.notes:
-Increased hammer damage.
-Added aim mode (RMB) to pistol.
-Added mini zoom
-Now you can reload your pistol at any time,not just when your mag is empty.
-Increased aim system for the Turret.
-Menu system facelift (If you press the menu button,you holster your tools.
-Emily has footsteps.
-Some tool icon added.(Pistol,Shovel,Hammer)

notes.title: Patch (2018.05.21)
notes.notes:
-Game now paused when you press F4 (Crafting manual)
-Emilys order system is now working better.
-2 more ally soldiers added to the training level.(Design)
-Aircraft bombing added to the training level.(Design)
-Now you can't see the sun flare while you are in Pause mode.
-Level1 Hints can't appear at the same time.
